passage.quote: Underlined passages connect the explanation to more detail. Opening a child makes it active on the right while retaining its parent on the left. A single destination opens directly; overlapping destinations are offered as a choice before navigation. Following an implementation link places the description containing that link beside the selected source.

from.quote: The reader combines explicit metadata links with child descriptions anchored to the current prose. It resolves each anchor to a range in the description. When links overlap, the text is divided at their boundaries so clicking a segment offers the destinations that actually cover that segment, rather than every link in the paragraph.
